### F90 — minor — Responses carry no request id — accepted

Every API response now carries an `X-Request-Id` header. Changes:

- `{A}`: the app sets `X-Request-Id` on every response and the smoke test asserts it.
- `{B}`: the client reads `X-Request-Id` and logs it next to each failed call.
Every response carries an `X-Request-Id` header, set by one middleware before the routes (Consensus F90).
